description: Source code for verifying name matching in X.509 certificates, including normalization and comparison of distinguished names, with functions for name matching, normalization, and handling of directory string types.

methods.name: NormalizeDirectoryString
methods.description: Normalizes a UTF-8 string by case folding and whitespace compression, enforcing charset rules if specified.

methods.name: NormalizeValue
methods.description: Converts an X509NameAttribute to a normalized, case-folded UTF-8 string.

methods.name: IsNormalizableDirectoryString
methods.description: Checks if a DER tag corresponds to a string type that can be normalized.

methods.name: VerifyValueMatch
methods.description: Checks if two X509NameAttributes match after normalization if applicable.

methods.name: VerifyNameMatch
methods.description: Checks if two distinguished names match exactly.

methods.name: VerifyNameInSubtree
methods.description: Checks if a name is within the subtree of a parent name.

methods.name: NameContainsEmailAddress
methods.description: Determines if a distinguished name contains an email address attribute.

methods.name: NormalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes a distinguished name into a canonical form.
